subject: Reply to CLUSTER SLOT-STATS ORDERBY with the slots it collected (#5131)
reason: The change only alters the CLUSTER SLOT-STATS ORDERBY reply array length, sizing it from the number of slots actually collected (i) instead of getMyShardSlotCount(). These two values are equal for a primary and for a single-level replica, so in every stable topology both builds produce byte-identical replies.
